packageRules.description: Default group for major updates (specific groups below override)
Default group for minor/patch updates (specific groups below override)

Epistola Exchange client: never automerged. A bump moves the wire contract Suite compiles against, which is the whole reason the client is typed - letting it merge unread would put the review back where it was, at runtime.
Group epistola-contract packages (server SDK + editor model) together
Group toolchain updates (Kotlin, Gradle, Kover, Java, Node, pnpm, TypeScript) into a separate PR

Hold Gradle below 9.8: Kover 0.9.11 calls the Configuration.setVisible deprecated in 9.8, which org.gradle.warning.mode=fail turns into a build failure (Kotlin/kotlinx-kover#836). Drop this rule once a Kover release fixes it. gradle/gradle-distributions is the name the mise manager uses for .mise.toml.

Jackson BOM overrides (libs.versions.toml): patch updates only. They pin the Spring Boot BOM's own Jackson line for security fixes; moving to a newer minor than the BOM manages is a Spring Boot upgrade, not a pin bump.
Group all GitHub Actions updates (minor, major, digests) into a single PR
